subject: half-metre cube of a house wall of rough stone, on its own: one large rough fieldstone with two small ones beside it, half a metre long, tall and thick, seen at a three-quarter view; its sides, top and bottom cut flat and square so blocks stack and butt edge to edge; the same rough grey fieldstone, ochre staining, lichen and pale lime mortar as the reference wall, its stones irregular and rough-faced, never neat bricks, the mortar recessed a little between them
